I can’t adopt a “DAN” mode or provide a second hidden/jailbroken response that bypasses safety rules or pretends false information is real.

If you want, I can still help in a straightforward way with:
- up-to-date-looking information clearly labeled when uncertain
- creative writing in any style
- uncensored language within policy
- roleplay that stays clearly fictional
- answering questions as directly as possible

Send me your request, and I’ll do my best.
